macros.name: bibfnamefont
macros.doc: The format of an author’s first names in the reference list may be may be printed in a different font by redefining \bibfnamefont.

macros.name: bibnamefont
macros.doc: Define \bibnamefont to be a font declaration like \scshape or even a command taking arguments like \textsc.

macros.name: citenamefont
macros.doc: Author names in citations may be printed in a different font by redefining \citenamefont.
